visual_summary: Inside a dense industrial cityscape, a large faceted bunker-like structure sits inside a glowing spherical field. In three narrow top panels, a bright vertical energy beam descends onto or through the structure; a luminous figure appears aligned with the beam, and a ghostly, symmetrical, imposing visage is superimposed behind the energy sphere. A control-room view shows the beam cutting across monitors while an armored observer watches. The final wide panel returns to the exterior, emphasizing the bunker enclosed in its field as the strike continues.
